_comment: v3 grid — Option C: trailing stop offset + ML exit threshold. Round 2 (36 combos) confirmed roi_multiplier is dead lever. Attacking win/loss asymmetry from both ends: tighter trail (bigger winners) + faster ML exit (smaller losers).

_grid_rationale.stoploss: Round 2 best at -0.030. Still the primary hard-floor lever. Testing -0.020 to -0.030.
_grid_rationale.trailing_offset: NEW v3: Offset at which trailing activates. Lower = lock in gains sooner. Testing 0.018-0.025 (1.8%-2.5% profit triggers trail).
_grid_rationale.ml_exit_threshold: NEW v3: How fast to exit on ML signal reversal. -0.001=very fast, -0.003=v5 original. Faster exit = smaller avg loser.
_grid_rationale.ml_threshold: Entry threshold. 0.009 gave 65% WR. 0.011 gave 48% (too few trades). Both tested.
_grid_rationale.atr_threshold: Skip flat market entries. 0.002=looser, 0.003=stricter. Both tested.

_removed_from_v2.roi_multiplier: CONFIRMED DEAD LEVER (Round 2, 36 combos). FreqAI ML exit fires before ROI is ever hit. Removed permanently from grid.
